## Motivation

Support [nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse) for document-image parsing. 

## Modifications

- Reuse existing RADIO vision encoder and add the model's content-normalized image positions and projection layers.
- Add causal visual-prefix mBART decoder, grouped-query attention and tied output weights.
- Reuse the checkpoint’s image processor and preserve image attachments in chat requests.

Support for the MTP head for Nemotron-3.5-Parse will be added in a follow-up PR.

## Accuracy Tests

Tested the [nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse) checkpoint on B200, H100 and A100.

| GPU | Tested configuration | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| B200 | Default FA4 attention and graphs | Four strict reference pages and concurrent/repeated checks pass; 180/180 repeated-request content checks pass. |
| H100 | FA3 attention and default decode graphs; overlap enabled and disabled | Basic parsing checks pass, but mixed-length concurrent requests can omit a line. |
| A100 | Default FlashInfer decoder, with `--mm-attention-backend sdpa` | Matches the reference on the four document fixtures and concurrent/repeated checks; 180/180 repeated-request content checks pass. |

Fixtures cover a paragraph, a two-column page, a table and a chart. Chat image requests and four concurrent pages with different text and dimensions also pass on all three GPUs. Published Transformers reference checks from the model card pass on H100 and A100.

Tested TP1 on A100, H100 and B200, and TP2 on two H100 NVL GPUs, with chat, batched requests and concurrent images. Both A100 and H100 load and serve with default settings, but some two-column outputs differ in formatting or reading order, or omit a line. The omission can also be reproduced by slightly changing the value of one coordinate token in the Transformers reference (from model card), suggesting that small numerical differences during decoding might contribute. On A100, passing `--mm-attention-backend sdpa` avoided the omission on the tested pages. No reliable H100 workaround has been confirmed. Pipeline parallelism is not implemented in this PR.

Launch command, adding the tested GPU-specific flags from the table. For TP2, add `--tp-size 2`:

```bash
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse \
  --revision 4035ffb1d8f8bafcdb867dfaf6f7514f101464f9 \
  --trust-remote-code --served-model-name nemotron-parse \
  --context-length 16384 --max-running-requests 4 \
  --max-total-tokens 16384 --mem-fraction-static 0.5 \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30001 --watchdog-timeout 900
```

The serving test renders its own document pages:

```bash
python3 test/registered/vlm/test_nemotron_parse_server.py
```

That test launches a default server. It checks raw generation, chat and distinct-page concurrency; the separate frozen-reference and repeated-page checks exposed the known issue above.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

TP1 with default attention and graph settings. Prefix, image-embedding and preprocessing caches were disabled. Every request used a different 850×1050 rendered document image, covering paragraphs, two-column text, tables and charts.

Each of three repetitions used eight separate warmup documents at the measured concurrency, then 20 requests at concurrency 1 and 40 at concurrency 4. Decoding used normal EOS stopping, a 1,024-token output cap and repetition penalty 1.1. Timings include image preprocessing, vision encoding, prefill and decoding.

| GPU | Concurrency 1, pages/s | Concurrency 4, pages/s |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| A100 80GB PCIe | 3.55–3.61 | 6.17–6.23 |
| H100 PCIe | 6.77–7.05 | 17.20–17.31 |
| B200 | 7.47–7.93 | 18.66–18.77 |

All 180 timed requests on each GPU contained the expected text, had valid boxes and ended on EOS. A100 used default Triton vision attention, without `--mm-attention-backend sdpa`. Caching was intentionally disabled for speed tests to avoid unrealistic speedups from re-processed documents.

Server command for these measurements:

```bash
SGLANG_VLM_CACHE_SIZE_MB=0 python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse \
  --revision 4035ffb1d8f8bafcdb867dfaf6f7514f101464f9 \
  --trust-remote-code --served-model-name nemotron-parse \
  --context-length 16384 --max-running-requests 4 \
  --max-total-tokens 16384 --mem-fraction-static 0.5 \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30001 --watchdog-timeout 900 \
  --disable-radix-cache --mm-preprocess-cache-size-mb 0
```

```bash
cat > benchmark_parse.py <<'EOF'
import argparse
import base64
import json
import re
import sys
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup


parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--url", default="http://127.0.0.1:30001")
parser.add_argument("--out", required=True)
parser.add_argument("--fixtures", type=Path, default=Path("parse-documents"))
parser.add_argument("--model-dir", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
sys.path.insert(0, args.model_dir)
from postprocessing import postprocess_document

root = args.fixtures
records = json.loads((root / "manifest.json").read_text())
assert len({item["pixel_sha256"] for item in records}) == len(records)
for item in records:
    item["image"] = (
        "data:image/png;base64,"
        + base64.b64encode((root / item["path"]).read_bytes()).decode()
    )
prompt = "</s><s><predict_bbox><predict_classes><output_markdown><predict_text_in_pic>"
models = requests.get(args.url + "/v1/models", timeout=30)
models.raise_for_status()
Path(args.out + ".models.json").write_text(json.dumps(models.json(), indent=2))


def parse_page(item):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    response = requests.post(
        args.url + "/generate",
        json={
            "text": prompt,
            "image_data": item["image"],
            "sampling_params": {
                "temperature": 0,
                "max_new_tokens": 1024,
                "repetition_penalty": 1.1,
                "skip_special_tokens": False,
            },
        },
        timeout=120,
    )
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
    response.raise_for_status()
    return {
        "index": item["index"],
        "kind": item["kind"],
        "seconds": elapsed,
        "response": response.json(),
    }


def check_page(result):
    item = records[result["index"]]
    data = result["response"]
    doc = postprocess_document(prompt + data["text"], image_size=(850, 1050))
    text = BeautifulSoup(doc["markdown"], "html.parser").get_text(" ")
    text = " ".join(text.replace("**", "").split())
    missing = [
        phrase
        for phrase in item["expected_text"]
        if not re.search(r"(?<!\w)" + re.escape(phrase) + r"(?!\w)", text)
    ]
    checks = {
        "expected_text": not missing,
        "normal_eos": data["meta_info"]["finish_reason"]["type"] == "stop",
        "valid_boxes": bool(doc["blocks"])
        and all(
            len(block["bbox"]) == 4
            and 0 <= block["bbox"][0] <= block["bbox"][2] <= 1
            and 0 <= block["bbox"][1] <= block["bbox"][3] <= 1
            for block in doc["blocks"]
        ),
        "no_warnings": not doc["warnings"],
        "no_cached_prefix": data["meta_info"].get("cached_tokens", 0) == 0,
    }
    result.update(
        checks=checks, missing_text=missing, passed=all(checks.values()), document=doc
    )


runs = []
cursor = 0
for repetition in range(3):
    for concurrency, count in ((1, 20), (4, 40)):
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=concurrency) as pool:
            warmups = list(pool.map(parse_page, records[cursor : cursor + 8]))
        cursor += 8
        selected = records[cursor : cursor + count]
        assert len(selected) == count
        cursor += count
        flush = requests.post(args.url + "/flush_cache", timeout=30)
        flush.raise_for_status()
        start = time.perf_counter()
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=concurrency) as pool:
            outputs = list(pool.map(parse_page, selected))
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
        for result in warmups + outputs:
            check_page(result)
        summary = {
            "repetition": repetition,
            "concurrency": concurrency,
            "requests": count,
            "seconds": elapsed,
            "pages_per_second": count / elapsed,
            "output_tokens_per_second": sum(
                result["response"]["meta_info"]["completion_tokens"]
                for result in outputs
            )
            / elapsed,
            "mean_latency_ms": 1000 * mean(result["seconds"] for result in outputs),
            "quality_passed": sum(result["passed"] for result in outputs),
            "cached_tokens": sum(
                result["response"]["meta_info"].get("cached_tokens", 0)
                for result in outputs
            ),
            "all_normal_eos": all(result["checks"]["normal_eos"] for result in outputs),
        }
        runs.append({**summary, "results": outputs, "warmups": warmups})
        Path(args.out).write_text(json.dumps(runs, indent=2))
        print(summary, flush=True)
assert cursor == len(records)
if any(run["quality_passed"] != run["requests"] for run in runs):
    raise RuntimeError(
        "Document checks failed; timings and all failed responses are preserved"
    )
EOF
```

+from sglang.srt.layers.linear import (
+    ColumnParallelLinear,
+    QKVParallelLinear,
+    RowParallelLinear,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+from sglang.srt.layers.radix_attention import RadixAttention
+from sglang.srt.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import VocabParallelEmbedding
+from sglang.srt.managers.mm_utils import general_mm_embed_routine, pad_mm_tokens
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import MultimodalDataItem, MultimodalInputs
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+from sglang.srt.model_loader.weight_utils import default_weight_loader
+from sglang.srt.models.radio import RadioModel
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.utils import add_prefix
+
+NECK_COMPRESSION = 4
+
+
+def content_normalized_positions(
+    pos_embed: torch.Tensor,
+    image_size: tuple[int, int],
+    content_size: tuple[int, int],
+    patch_size: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    height, width = content_size
+    rows, cols = (size // patch_size for size in image_size)
+    source_side = math.isqrt(pos_embed.shape[1])
+    field = (
+        pos_embed.reshape(1, source_side, source_side, -1).permute(0, 3, 1, 2).float()
+    )
+    content_grid = (math.ceil(height / patch_size), math.ceil(width / patch_size))
+    if min(content_grid) == 1:
+        field = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(field, content_grid)
+    else:
+        field = F.interpolate(
+            field,
+            size=content_grid,
+            mode="bilinear",
+            align_corners=False,
+            antialias=True,
+        )
+
+    def centers(count, extent):
+        starts = (
+            torch.arange(count, device=pos_embed.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+            * patch_size
+        )
+        # Partial edge patches use the center of their unpadded content.
+        spans = (extent - starts).clamp(0, patch_size)
+        return (starts + spans / 2).clamp(max=extent) / extent * 2 - 1
+
+    y, x = torch.meshgrid(centers(rows, height), centers(cols, width), indexing="ij")
+    grid = torch.stack((x, y), dim=-1).unsqueeze(0)
+    positions = F.grid_sample(
+        field, grid, mode="bilinear", padding_mode="border", align_corners=False
+    )
+    return positions.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2).to(pos_embed.dtype)
+
+
+class NemotronParseVision(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__()
+        encoder = config.encoder
+        radio_config = RadioConfig(
+            model_name=encoder.args["model"],
+            patch_size=encoder.patch_size,
+            max_img_size=encoder.max_resolution,
+            reg_tokens=encoder.args["register_multiple"],
+        )
+        self.model_encoder = RadioModel(radio_config)
+        self.pack_pages = (
+            self.model_encoder.model.encoder.layers[0].attn.attn.qkv_backend_name
+            != "sdpa"
+        )
+        self.patch_size = radio_config.patch_size
+        self.num_prefix_tokens = self.model_encoder.model.patch_generator.num_skip
+        hidden = config.decoder.d_model
+        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(radio_config.hidden_size, hidden, 1)
+        self.layer_norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden, eps=1e-6)
+        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(
+            hidden,
+            hidden,
+            (1, NECK_COMPRESSION),
+            stride=(1, NECK_COMPRESSION),
+            bias=False,
+        )
+        self.layer_norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden, eps=1e-6)
+        self.register_buffer(
+            "summary_idxs",
+            torch.arange(config.vision_summary_dim // radio_config.hidden_size),
+        )
+        self.sum_proj = nn.Linear(config.vision_summary_dim, hidden)
+        self.layer_norm3 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden, eps=1e-6)
+
+    def forward(self, items: list[MultimodalDataItem]) -> torch.Tensor:
+        backbone = self.model_encoder.model
+        patches = backbone.patch_generator
+        pages, sizes, boundaries = [], [], [0]
+        for item in items:
+            size = tuple(item.model_specific_data["image_size"])
+            content = tuple(item.model_specific_data["content_size"])
+            pixels = item.feature.to(
+                device=self.conv1.weight.device, dtype=self.conv1.weight.dtype
+            )
+            page = patches.embedder(pixels).unsqueeze(0)
+            page = page + content_normalized_positions(
+                patches.pos_embed, size, content, self.patch_size
+            )
+            page = patches.cls_token(page)
+            pages.append(page)
+            sizes.append(size)
+            boundaries.append(boundaries[-1] + page.shape[1])
+        if self.pack_pages:
+            hidden = backbone.encoder(
+                inputs_embeds=torch.cat(pages, dim=1),
+                cu_seqlens=torch.tensor(
+                    boundaries, dtype=torch.int32, device=pages[0].device
+                ),
+                return_dict=False,
+            )[0]
+        else:
+            # SDPA expects padded batches, so encode variable-size pages separately.
+            hidden = torch.cat(
+                [
+                    backbone.encoder(inputs_embeds=page, return_dict=False)[0]
+                    for page in pages
+                ],
+                dim=1,
+            )
+        features = []
+        for i, (height, width) in enumerate(sizes):
+            page = hidden[:, boundaries[i] : boundaries[i + 1]]
+            summary = self.layer_norm3(
+                self.sum_proj(page[:, self.summary_idxs].flatten(1))
+            ).unsqueeze(1)
+            spatial = page[:, self.num_prefix_tokens :]
+            spatial = self.layer_norm1(
+                self.conv1(spatial.transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)
+            )
+            spatial = spatial.transpose(1, 2).reshape(
+                1, -1, height // self.patch_size, width // self.patch_size
+            )
+            spatial = self.layer_norm2(self.conv2(spatial).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2))
+            features.append(torch.cat((spatial, summary), dim=1).squeeze(0))
+        return torch.cat(features)
+
+
+class NemotronParseAttention(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config, layer_id, quant_config, prefix):
+        super().__init__()
+        tp_size = get_parallel().tp_size
+        total_heads = config.decoder_attention_heads
+        total_kv_heads = config.self_attention_kv_heads
+        if total_heads % tp_size or (
+            total_kv_heads >= tp_size and total_kv_heads % tp_size
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Parse attention heads must be divisible by the tensor parallel size"
+            )
+        if total_kv_heads < tp_size and tp_size % total_kv_heads:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Tensor parallel size must divide or be divisible by Parse KV heads"
+            )
+        self.head_dim = config.d_model // total_heads
+        self.q_size = total_heads // tp_size * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = max(1, total_kv_heads // tp_size) * self.head_dim
+        self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+            config.d_model,
+            self.head_dim,
+            total_heads,
+            total_kv_heads,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=add_prefix("qkv_proj", prefix),
+        )
+        self.out_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            config.d_model,
+            config.d_model,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=add_prefix("out_proj", prefix),
+        )
+        # The trained visual prefix is causal and uses no positional rotation.
+        self.attn = RadixAttention(
+            total_heads // tp_size,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.head_dim**-0.5,
+            num_kv_heads=max(1, total_kv_heads // tp_size),
+            layer_id=layer_id,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, forward_batch):
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split((self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size), dim=-1)
+        output = self.attn(q, k, v, forward_batch)
+        return self.out_proj(output)[0]
+
+
+class NemotronParseDecoderLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config, layer_id, quant_config, prefix):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.self_attn = NemotronParseAttention(
+            config, layer_id, quant_config, add_prefix("self_attn", prefix)
+        )
+        self.self_attn_layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.d_model)
+        self.final_layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.d_model)
+        self.activation = get_act_fn(config.activation_function)
+        self.fc1 = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            config.d_model,
+            config.decoder_ffn_dim,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=add_prefix("fc1", prefix),
+        )
+        self.fc2 = RowParallelLinear(
+            config.decoder_ffn_dim,
+            config.d_model,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=add_prefix("fc2", prefix),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, forward_batch):
+        hidden_states = hidden_states + self.self_attn(
+            self.self_attn_layer_norm(hidden_states), forward_batch
+        )
+        output, _ = self.fc1(self.final_layer_norm(hidden_states))
+        output, _ = self.fc2(self.activation(output))
+        return hidden_states + output
+
+
+class NemotronParseEmbedding(VocabParallelEmbedding):
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__(config.vocab_size, config.d_model)
+        self.scale = math.sqrt(config.d_model) if config.scale_embedding else 1.0
+
+    def forward(self, input_ids):
+        return super().forward(input_ids) * self.scale
+
+
+class NemotronParseDecoder(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config, quant_config, prefix):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.embed_tokens = NemotronParseEmbedding(config)
+        self.layernorm_embedding = nn.LayerNorm(config.d_model)
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            [
+                NemotronParseDecoderLayer(
+                    config, i, quant_config, add_prefix(f"layers.{i}", prefix)
+                )
+                for i in range(config.decoder_layers)
+            ]
+        )
+        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.d_model)
+
+    def forward(self, input_embeds, forward_batch):
+        hidden_states = self.layernorm_embedding(input_embeds)
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            hidden_states = layer(hidden_states, forward_batch)
+        return self.layer_norm(hidden_states)
+
+
+class RadioMBartPrefixForCausalLM(nn.Module):
+    merge_by_field_config = False

detail.body:
## Motivation

Support [nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse) for document-image parsing. 

## Modifications

- Reuse existing RADIO vision encoder and add the model's content-normalized image positions and projection layers.
- Add causal visual-prefix mBART decoder, grouped-query attention and tied output weights.
- Reuse the checkpoint’s image processor and preserve image attachments in chat requests.

Support for the MTP head for Nemotron-3.5-Parse will be added in a follow-up PR.

## Accuracy Tests

Tested the [nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse) checkpoint on B200, H100 and A100.

| GPU | Tested configuration | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| B200 | Default FA4 attention and graphs | Four strict reference pages and concurrent/repeated checks pass; 180/180 repeated-request content checks pass. |
| H100 | FA3 attention and default decode graphs; overlap enabled and disabled | Basic parsing checks pass, but mixed-length concurrent requests can omit a line. |
| A100 | Default FlashInfer decoder, with `--mm-attention-backend sdpa` | Matches the reference on the four document fixtures and concurrent/repeated checks; 180/180 repeated-request content checks pass. |

Fixtures cover a paragraph, a two-column page, a table and a chart. Chat image requests and four concurrent pages with different text and dimensions also pass on all three GPUs. Published Transformers reference checks from the model card pass on H100 and A100.

Tested TP1 on A100, H100 and B200, and TP2 on two H100 NVL GPUs, with chat, batched requests and concurrent images. Both A100 and H100 load and serve with default settings, but some two-column outputs differ in formatting or reading order, or omit a line. The omission can also be reproduced by slightly changing the value of one coordinate token in the Transformers reference (from model card), suggesting that small numerical differences during decoding might contribute. On A100, passing `--mm-attention-backend sdpa` avoided the omission on the tested pages. No reliable H100 workaround has been confirmed. Pipeline parallelism is not implemented in this PR.

Launch command, adding the tested GPU-specific flags from the table. For TP2, add `--tp-size 2`:

```bash
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse \
  --revision 4035ffb1d8f8bafcdb867dfaf6f7514f101464f9 \
  --trust-remote-code --served-model-name nemotron-parse \
  --context-length 16384 --max-running-requests 4 \
  --max-total-tokens 16384 --mem-fraction-static 0.5 \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30001 --watchdog-timeout 900
```

The serving test renders its own document pages:

```bash
python3 test/registered/vlm/test_nemotron_parse_server.py
```

That test launches a default server. It checks raw generation, chat and distinct-page concurrency; the separate frozen-reference and repeated-page checks exposed the known issue above.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

TP1 with default attention and graph settings. Prefix, image-embedding and preprocessing caches were disabled. Every request used a different 850×1050 rendered document image, covering paragraphs, two-column text, tables and charts.

Each of three repetitions used eight separate warmup documents at the measured concurrency, then 20 requests at concurrency 1 and 40 at concurrency 4. Decoding used normal EOS stopping, a 1,024-token output cap and repetition penalty 1.1. Timings include image preprocessing, vision encoding, prefill and decoding.

| GPU | Concurrency 1, pages/s | Concurrency 4, pages/s |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| A100 80GB PCIe | 3.55–3.61 | 6.17–6.23 |
| H100 PCIe | 6.77–7.05 | 17.20–17.31 |
| B200 | 7.47–7.93 | 18.66–18.77 |

All 180 timed requests on each GPU contained the expected text, had valid boxes and ended on EOS. A100 used default Triton vision attention, without `--mm-attention-backend sdpa`. Caching was intentionally disabled for speed tests to avoid unrealistic speedups from re-processed documents.

Server command for these measurements:

```bash
SGLANG_VLM_CACHE_SIZE_MB=0 python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse \
  --revision 4035ffb1d8f8bafcdb867dfaf6f7514f101464f9 \
  --trust-remote-code --served-model-name nemotron-parse \
  --context-length 16384 --max-running-requests 4 \
  --max-total-tokens 16384 --mem-fraction-static 0.5 \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30001 --watchdog-timeout 900 \
  --disable-radix-cache --mm-preprocess-cache-size-mb 0
```

```bash
import argparse
import base64
import json
import re
import sys
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup


parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--url", default="http://127.0.0.1:30001")
parser.add_argument("--out", required=True)
parser.add_argument("--fixtures", type=Path, default=Path("parse-documents"))
parser.add_argument("--model-dir", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
sys.path.insert(0, args.model_dir)
from postprocessing import postprocess_document

root = args.fixtures
records = json.loads((root / "manifest.json").read_text())
assert len({item["pixel_sha256"] for item in records}) == len(records)
for item in records:
    item["image"] = (
        "data:image/png;base64,"
        + base64.b64encode((root / item["path"]).read_bytes()).decode()
    )
prompt = "</s><s><predict_bbox><predict_classes><output_markdown><predict_text_in_pic>"
models = requests.get(args.url + "/v1/models", timeout=30)
models.raise_for_status()
Path(args.out + ".models.json").write_text(json.dumps(models.json(), indent=2))


def parse_page(item):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    response = requests.post(
        args.url + "/generate",
        json={
            "text": prompt,
            "image_data": item["image"],
            "sampling_params": {
                "temperature": 0,
                "max_new_tokens": 1024,
                "repetition_penalty": 1.1,
                "skip_special_tokens": False,
            },
        },
        timeout=120,
    )
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
    response.raise_for_status()
    return {
        "index": item["index"],
        "kind": item["kind"],
        "seconds": elapsed,
        "response": response.json(),
    }


def check_page(result):
    item = records[result["index"]]
    data = result["response"]
    doc = postprocess_document(prompt + data["text"], image_size=(850, 1050))
    text = BeautifulSoup(doc["markdown"], "html.parser").get_text(" ")
    text = " ".join(text.replace("**", "").split())
    missing = [
        phrase
        for phrase in item["expected_text"]
        if not re.search(r"(?<!\w)" + re.escape(phrase) + r"(?!\w)", text)
    ]
    checks = {
        "expected_text": not missing,
        "normal_eos": data["meta_info"]["finish_reason"]["type"] == "stop",
        "valid_boxes": bool(doc["blocks"])
        and all(
            len(block["bbox"]) == 4
            and 0 <= block["bbox"][0] <= block["bbox"][2] <= 1
            and 0 <= block["bbox"][1] <= block["bbox"][3] <= 1
            for block in doc["blocks"]
        ),
        "no_warnings": not doc["warnings"],
        "no_cached_prefix": data["meta_info"].get("cached_tokens", 0) == 0,
    }
    result.update(
        checks=checks, missing_text=missing, passed=all(checks.values()), document=doc
    )


runs = []
cursor = 0
for repetition in range(3):
    for concurrency, count in ((1, 20), (4, 40)):
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=concurrency) as pool:
            warmups = list(pool.map(parse_page, records[cursor : cursor + 8]))
        cursor += 8
        selected = records[cursor : cursor + count]
        assert len(selected) == count
        cursor += count
        flush = requests.post(args.url + "/flush_cache", timeout=30)
        flush.raise_for_status()
```

+import math
+from array import array
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+from torch.nn import functional as F

+from sglang.srt.layers.activation import get_act_fn

+    RowParallelLinear,

+from sglang.srt.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import VocabParallelEmbedding
+from sglang.srt.managers.mm_utils import general_mm_embed_routine, pad_mm_tokens
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import MultimodalDataItem, MultimodalInputs
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+from sglang.srt.model_loader.weight_utils import default_weight_loader
+from sglang.srt.models.radio import RadioModel
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.utils import add_prefix
+
+NECK_COMPRESSION = 4
+
+
+def content_normalized_positions(
+    pos_embed: torch.Tensor,
+    image_size: tuple[int, int],
+    content_size: tuple[int, int],
+    patch_size: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    height, width = content_size
+    rows, cols = (size // patch_size for size in image_size)
+    source_side = math.isqrt(pos_embed.shape[1])
+    field = (
+        pos_embed.reshape(1, source_side, source_side, -1).permute(0, 3, 1, 2).float()
+    )
+    content_grid = (math.ceil(height / patch_size), math.ceil(width / patch_size))
+    if min(content_grid) == 1:
+        field = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(field, content_grid)
+    else:
+        field = F.interpolate(
+            field,
+            size=content_grid,
+            mode="bilinear",
+            align_corners=False,
+            antialias=True,
+        )
+
+    def centers(count, extent):
+        starts = (
+            torch.arange(count, device=pos_embed.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+            * patch_size
+        )
+        # Partial edge patches use the center of their unpadded content.
+        spans = (extent - starts).clamp(0, patch_size)
+        return (starts + spans / 2).clamp(max=extent) / extent * 2 - 1
+
+    y, x = torch.meshgrid(centers(rows, height), centers(cols, width), indexing="ij")
+    grid = torch.stack((x, y), dim=-1).unsqueeze(0)
+    positions = F.grid_sample(
+        field, grid, mode="bilinear", padding_mode="border", align_corners=False
+    )
+    return positions.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2).to(pos_embed.dtype)
+
+
+class NemotronParseVision(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__()
+        encoder = config.encoder
+        radio_config = RadioConfig(
+            model_name=encoder.args["model"],
+            patch_size=encoder.patch_size,
+            max_img_size=encoder.max_resolution,
+            reg_tokens=encoder.args["register_multiple"],
+        )
+        self.model_encoder = RadioModel(radio_config)
+        self.pack_pages = (
+            self.model_encoder.model.encoder.layers[0].attn.attn.qkv_backend_name
+            != "sdpa"
+        )
+        self.patch_size = radio_config.patch_size
+        self.num_prefix_tokens = self.model_encoder.model.patch_generator.num_skip
+        hidden = config.decoder.d_model
+        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(radio_config.hidden_size, hidden, 1)
+        self.layer_norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden, eps=1e-6)
+        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(
+            hidden,
+            hidden,
+            (1, NECK_COMPRESSION),
+            stride=(1, NECK_COMPRESSION),
+            bias=False,
+        )
+        self.layer_norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden, eps=1e-6)
+        self.register_buffer(
+            "summary_idxs",
+            torch.arange(config.vision_summary_dim // radio_config.hidden_size),
+        )
+        self.sum_proj = nn.Linear(config.vision_summary_dim, hidden)
+        self.layer_norm3 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden, eps=1e-6)
+
+    def forward(self, items: list[MultimodalDataItem]) -> torch.Tensor:
+        backbone = self.model_encoder.model
+        patches = backbone.patch_generator
+        pages, sizes, boundaries = [], [], [0]
+        for item in items:
+            size = tuple(item.model_specific_data["image_size"])
+            content = tuple(item.model_specific_data["content_size"])
+            pixels = item.feature.to(
+                device=self.conv1.weight.device, dtype=self.conv1.weight.dtype
+            )
+            page = patches.embedder(pixels).unsqueeze(0)
+            page = page + content_normalized_positions(
+                patches.pos_embed, size, content, self.patch_size
+            )
+            page = patches.cls_token(page)
+            pages.append(page)
+            sizes.append(size)
+            boundaries.append(boundaries[-1] + page.shape[1])
+        if self.pack_pages:
+            hidden = backbone.encoder(
+                inputs_embeds=torch.cat(pages, dim=1),
+                cu_seqlens=torch.tensor(
+                    boundaries, dtype=torch.int32, device=pages[0].device
+                ),
+                return_dict=False,
+            )[0]
+        else:
+            # SDPA expects padded batches, so encode variable-size pages separately.
+            hidden = torch.cat(
+                [
+                    backbone.encoder(inputs_embeds=page, return_dict=False)[0]
+                    for page in pages
+                ],
+                dim=1,
+            )
+        features = []
+        for i, (height, width) in enumerate(sizes):
+            page = hidden[:, boundaries[i] : boundaries[i + 1]]
+            summary = self.layer_norm3(
+                self.sum_proj(page[:, self.summary_idxs].flatten(1))
+            ).unsqueeze(1)
+            spatial = page[:, self.num_prefix_tokens :]
+            spatial = self.layer_norm1(
+                self.conv1(spatial.transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)
+            )
+            spatial = spatial.transpose(1, 2).reshape(
+                1, -1, height // self.patch_size, width // self.patch_size
+            )
+            spatial = self.layer_norm2(self.conv2(spatial).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2))
+            features.append(torch.cat((spatial, summary), dim=1).squeeze(0))
+        return torch.cat(features)
+
+
+class NemotronParseAttention(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config, layer_id, quant_config, prefix):
+        super().__init__()
+        tp_size = get_parallel().tp_size
+        total_heads = config.decoder_attention_heads
+        total_kv_heads = config.self_attention_kv_heads
+        if total_heads % tp_size or (
+            total_kv_heads >= tp_size and total_kv_heads % tp_size
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Parse attention heads must be divisible by the tensor parallel size"
+            )
+        if total_kv_heads < tp_size and tp_size % total_kv_heads:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Tensor parallel size must divide or be divisible by Parse KV heads"
+            )
+        self.head_dim = config.d_model // total_heads
+        self.q_size = total_heads // tp_size * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = max(1, total_kv_heads // tp_size) * self.head_dim
+        self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+            config.d_model,
+            self.head_dim,
+            total_heads,
+            total_kv_heads,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=add_prefix("qkv_proj", prefix),
+        )
+        self.out_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            config.d_model,
+            config.d_model,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=add_prefix("out_proj", prefix),
+        )
+        # The trained visual prefix is causal and uses no positional rotation.
+        self.attn = RadixAttention(
+            total_heads // tp_size,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.head_dim**-0.5,
+            num_kv_heads=max(1, total_kv_heads // tp_size),
+            layer_id=layer_id,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, forward_batch):
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split((self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size), dim=-1)
+        output = self.attn(q, k, v, forward_batch)
+        return self.out_proj(output)[0]
+
+
+class NemotronParseDecoderLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config, layer_id, quant_config, prefix):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.self_attn = NemotronParseAttention(
+            config, layer_id, quant_config, add_prefix("self_attn", prefix)
+        )
+        self.self_attn_layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.d_model)
+        self.final_layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.d_model)
+        self.activation = get_act_fn(config.activation_function)
+        self.fc1 = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            config.d_model,
+            config.decoder_ffn_dim,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=add_prefix("fc1", prefix),
+        )
+        self.fc2 = RowParallelLinear(
+            config.decoder_ffn_dim,
+            config.d_model,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=add_prefix("fc2", prefix),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, forward_batch):
+        hidden_states = hidden_states + self.self_attn(
+            self.self_attn_layer_norm(hidden_states), forward_batch
+        )
+        output, _ = self.fc1(self.final_layer_norm(hidden_states))
+        output, _ = self.fc2(self.activation(output))
+        return hidden_states + output
+
+
+class NemotronParseEmbedding(VocabParallelEmbedding):
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__(config.vocab_size, config.d_model)
+        self.scale = math.sqrt(config.d_model) if config.scale_embedding else 1.0
+
+    def forward(self, input_ids):
+        return super().forward(input_ids) * self.scale
+
+
+class NemotronParseDecoder(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config, quant_config, prefix):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.embed_tokens = NemotronParseEmbedding(config)
+        self.layernorm_embedding = nn.LayerNorm(config.d_model)
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            [
+                NemotronParseDecoderLayer(
+                    config, i, quant_config, add_prefix(f"layers.{i}", prefix)
+                )
+                for i in range(config.decoder_layers)
+            ]
+        )
+        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(config.d_model)
+
+    def forward(self, input_embeds, forward_batch):
+        hidden_states = self.layernorm_embedding(input_embeds)
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            hidden_states = layer(hidden_states, forward_batch)
+        return self.layer_norm(hidden_states)
+
+
+class RadioMBartPrefixForCausalLM(nn.Module):
+    merge_by_field_config = False
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_placeholder_str(cls, modality: str, i: int) -> str | None:
+        if modality.startswith("image"):
+            return None
+        raise ValueError("Nemotron Parse supports document images only")
+
+    def __init__(self, *, config, quant_config=None, prefix="", **kwargs):
+        super().__init__()
+        if not config.legacy_causal_vision_prefix or config.decoder.add_cross_attention:
+            raise ValueError("Nemotron Parse requires the causal visual-prefix decoder")
+        self.config = config
+        self.encoder = NemotronParseVision(config)
+        self.decoder = NemotronParseDecoder(
+            config.decoder, quant_config, add_prefix("decoder", prefix)
+        )
+        self.lm_head = self.decoder.embed_tokens
+        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(config)
+
+    def get_input_embeddings(self):
+        return self.decoder.embed_tokens
+
+    def get_embed_and_head(self):
+        return self.decoder.embed_tokens.weight, self.lm_head.weight
+
+    def pad_input_ids(self, input_ids: array, mm_inputs: MultimodalInputs) -> array:
+        return pad_mm_tokens(input_ids, mm_inputs)
+
+    def get_image_feature(self, items: list[MultimodalDataItem]) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.encoder(items)
+
+    def forward(
+        self, input_ids, positions, forward_batch: ForwardBatch, input_embeds=None
+    ):
+        if input_embeds is None:
+            return general_mm_embed_routine(
+                input_ids=input_ids,
+                forward_batch=forward_batch,
+                language_model=self,
+                multimodal_model=self,
+                positions=positions,
+            )
+        hidden_states = self.decoder(input_embeds, forward_batch)
+        return self.logits_processor(
+            input_ids, hidden_states, self.lm_head, forward_batch
+        )
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights):
+        params = dict(self.named_parameters())
+        radio_weights = []
+        loaded = set()
+        for name, weight in weights:
+            # Auxiliary projections belong to MTP, not normal decoding.
+            if name.startswith(("decoder.extra_heads.", "decoder.extra_proj.")):
+                continue
+            if name.startswith("encoder.model_encoder."):
+                radio_name = name.removeprefix("encoder.model_encoder.")
+                if radio_name == "radio_model.summary_idxs":
+                    default_weight_loader(self.encoder.summary_idxs, weight)
+                    continue
+                if radio_name in {
+                    "radio_model.input_conditioner.norm_mean",
+                    "radio_model.input_conditioner.norm_std",
+                }:
+                    # The published image processor already normalizes the patches.
+                    continue
+                radio_weights.append((radio_name, weight))
+                continue
+            if name == "lm_head.weight":
+                name = "decoder.embed_tokens.weight"
+            for source, shard in (("q_proj", "q"), ("k_proj", "k"), ("v_proj", "v")):
+                if f".self_attn.{source}." in name:
+                    name = name.replace(f".self_attn.{source}.", ".self_attn.qkv_proj.")
+                    param = params[name]
+                    param.weight_loader(param, weight, shard)
+                    loaded.add(name)
+                    break
+            else:
+                param = params[name]
+                if name.startswith("decoder.embed_tokens.") or any(
+                    part in name for part in (".self_attn.out_proj.", ".fc1.", ".fc2.")
+                ):
+                    param.weight_loader(param, weight)
+                else:
+                    default_weight_loader(param, weight)
+                loaded.add(name)
+        radio_loaded = self.encoder.model_encoder.load_weights(radio_weights)
+        loaded.update(f"encoder.model_encoder.{name}" for name in radio_loaded)
+        # The shared RADIO layers initialize LayerScale to one; SO400M has none.
+        synthetic = {
+            name
+            for name in params
+            if name.startswith("encoder.model_encoder.")
+            and name.endswith((".ls1", ".ls2"))
+        }
+        missing = params.keys() - loaded - synthetic
+        if missing:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Missing Nemotron Parse checkpoint parameters: {sorted(missing)}"
+            )
+        return loaded
+
+
+EntryClass = RadioMBartPrefixForCausalLM
